mitigation_notes.recommended_mitigation: Upgrade and continuously audit pinned deps (next 16.4.1, js-yaml 4.3.2, x/net 0.55.0); add an advisory gate
Feed secrets to security(1) on stdin, never argv; remove --token argv path
Never expand untrusted plan ids in shell completion; literal prefix-match
Bound/attribute tokens: max expiry, created_by/last_used, list endpoint, per-owner tenancy
Set CSP default-src 'self' and frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options on the hosted app
Authenticate local dashboard beyond ambient CSRF; require Origin; per-user 0600 token
Bind credential to issuing site, refuse redirects on credential-bearing requests, size/time caps
Least-privilege Neon/Blob, separate migrate role, rotate on teardown
Add plan-content purge/retention and pre-push secret scanning
